title: Give me a 1 sentence summary of sepsis.

messages.content: Give me a 1 sentence summary of sepsis.

Sepsis is a life-threatening condition that occurs when the body's response to an infection becomes uncontrolled and causes widespread inflammation, potentially leading to organ failure (1).

Reference:
(1) Singer M, Deutschman CS, Seymour CW, et al. The Third International Consensus Definitions for Sepsis and Septic Shock (Sepsis-3). JAMA. 2016;315(8):801-810. doi: 10.1001/jama.2016.0287
